description: This file is a shell script for testing various behaviors of Git related to handling large files and big file configurations. It contains setup procedures, test cases for adding large files, configuring thresholds, and verifying packfile management.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects success for the given command sequence.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that the command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that the output (usually stderr or stdout) is empty.

methods.name: test_file_size
methods.description: Returns the size of the specified file.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks that the specified path exists and is a file.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks that the specified path does not exist.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new Git repository in the specified directory.

methods.name: test_oid
methods.description: Determines the object ID algorithm used by the repository.

methods.name: test_tool
methods.description: A helper for generating random data.
